name: LangChain
subtitle: Framework for LLM apps and agents
creator: Harrison Chase
description: A framework for building apps on language models: connecting models to your documents (retrieval-augmented generation), chaining steps and building agents. LangGraph, its sibling, handles long-running, stateful agents.

concepts.explanation: Look up relevant documents, then ask the model.
Models that decide which tools to call.
Graphs of agent steps with memory.

codeSamples.label: Python
codeSamples.code:
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate

model = init_chat_model("anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5")
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("system", "Answer using only this context: {context}"),
    ("user", "{question}"),
])

chain = prompt | model
answer = chain.invoke({"context": docs_text, "question": "What is the refund policy?"})

pricing.summary: Framework is free and open source. LangSmith (tracing and evaluation) has free and paid plans.
